- Initial release of the travel-hotel-research skill.
- Search and compare hotels, flights, attractions, short-term rentals, and live events across Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, TripAdvisor, Trip.com, Airbnb, and Ticketmaster using the Crawlora API.
- Returns clean, normalized JSON results—no page scraping needed.
- Supports price comparison, reviews lookup, flight search, attraction/event discovery, and Airbnb listing/host research.
- Includes setup instructions for the Crawlora API key and usage examples for each supported travel platform.
